description.value: Best Quality Sweets & Restaurant is a fully vegetarian Indian eatery on Vancouver's Main Street, serving an extensive menu of North Indian curries, thalis, breads, chaats, and traditional sweets. The restaurant offers online ordering with a 15-minute pickup window, making it a practical stop for cyclists riding the Main Street corridor. Its exclusively plant-based menu is a rarity among Indian restaurants in the city and appeals to a wide range of dietary preferences.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates all OSM contact fields (address 7260 Main St, phone +1 604-324-6677). The site and OSM tag diet:vegetarian=only both confirm the menu is entirely vegetarian; the website also explicitly states 'Serving: Vegetarian food, Indian food' and the full menu has no non-vegetarian items. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all required criteria and most optional amenities remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating restaurant well-suited to cyclists on the Main Street corridor, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A brief on-site or phone check to confirm these basics is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website added postal code V5X3J4 not present in OSM address field; used website value as more complete.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Serving: Vegetarian food, Indian food'; entire published menu contains no meat or fish items
